decisions.statement: A run over a file that is already there is refused unless a figure is said to have been seen.
A run file's path is never defaulted to somewhere plausible.
The Monarch pages are marked before and after a run.
A run says whether anything moved under that run.
Batches are asked four at a time rather than one by one or every batch at once.
The categories offered and the rows drawn and the proposals and the cost are all kept.
A stratum that could not fill its draw says so as the run goes.
Nothing here writes to Monarch or to our copy.

definition: one scored run of the agent over a drawn sample, kept as a file
